{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RtRyxLeL3qd3hupcACpF91","type":"tool_result","content":"30\t\n31\t## Decision (WHAT)\n32\t\n33\t`SensorReading` payload has two schema versions, `V1` (legacy, no `raw_value`) and `V2` (mandatory `raw_value`). `payloadVersion: 1 | 2` is a required discriminator on every event.\n34\t\n35\t1. **Ajv schemas** (`libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/sensor-events.schema.ts`):\n36\t   - `SensorPayloadV1Schema` — no `raw_value`, `payloadVersion = 1`, `additionalProperties: false`.\n37\t   - `SensorPayloadV2Schema` — `raw_value: number` REQUIRED, `payloadVersion = 2`, `additionalProperties: false`.\n38\t\n39\t2. **Upcaster** (`libs/event-contracts/src/upcasters/sensor-payload-v1-to-v2.ts`) — when a V1 event arrives, `raw_value = value` mapping produces a V2 struct **tagged** with `source: UpcastedFromV1`. The upcaster is a read-only translator at consumer boundaries; it does NOT re-emit.\n40\t\n41\t3. **Downcaster** (`libs/event-contracts/src/downcasters/sensor-payload-v2-to-v1.ts`) — mirror direction, drops `raw_value`, sets `payloadVersion = 1`. Used only during deploy windows where V1-only consumers still exist.\n42\t\n43\t4. **Rust side** (`crates/event-contracts-rs/src/sensor.rs`):\n44\t\n45\t   ```rust\n46\t   pub enum PayloadSource { OriginalV2, UpcastedFromV1 }\n47\t   pub struct SensorReading {\n48\t     pub value: f64,\n49\t     pub raw_value: f64,\n50\t     pub source: PayloadSource,\n51\t   }\n52\t   ```\n53\t\n54\t   Persistence-layer audit log when `source == UpcastedFromV1 && raw_value == value` — semantic shadow for observability."}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6323ea1e-ccb9-4873-9219-49241266a3fe","uuid":"7a1911cb-b8ab-4b03-a225-7725123be13c","timestamp":"2026-10-05T11:57:23.494Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-5718cfe3d310/docs/adr/_draft/028-sensor-payload-raw-value-contract.md","content":"\n## Decision (WHAT)\n\n`SensorReading` payload has two schema versions, `V1` (legacy, no `raw_value`) and `V2` (mandatory `raw_value`). `payloadVersion: 1 | 2` is a required discriminator on every event.\n\n1. **Ajv schemas** (`libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/sensor-events.schema.ts`):\n   - `SensorPayloadV1Schema` — no `raw_value`, `payloadVersion = 1`, `additionalProperties: false`.\n   - `SensorPayloadV2Schema` — `raw_value: number` REQUIRED, `payloadVersion = 2`, `additionalProperties: false`.\n\n2. **Upcaster** (`libs/event-contracts/src/upcasters/sensor-payload-v1-to-v2.ts`) — when a V1 event arrives, `raw_value = value` mapping produces a V2 struct **tagged** with `source: UpcastedFromV1`. The upcaster is a read-only translator at consumer boundaries; it does NOT re-emit.\n\n3. **Downcaster** (`libs/event-contracts/src/downcasters/sensor-payload-v2-to-v1.ts`) — mirror direction, drops `raw_value`, sets `payloadVersion = 1`. Used only during deploy windows where V1-only consumers still exist.\n\n4. **Rust side** (`crates/event-contracts-rs/src/sensor.rs`):\n\n   ```rust\n   pub enum PayloadSource { OriginalV2, UpcastedFromV1 }\n   pub struct SensorReading {\n     pub value: f64,\n     pub raw_value: f64,\n     pub source: PayloadSource,\n   }\n   ```\n\n   Persistence-layer audit log when `source == UpcastedFromV1 && raw_value == value` — semantic shadow for observability.","numLines":25,"startLine":30,"totalLines":119}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BjN5LamUT83Lr6oeJFBZmH","type":"tool_result","content":"104\t- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — green.\n105\t- `RUSTDOCFLAGS=\"-D warnings\" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --document-private-items` — green.\n106\t- Phase-progression runbook `docs/runbooks/sensor-payload-v2-migration.md` — pending (follow-up commit; the runbook is not blocking Phase 0 posture because Phase 0 is the default-accept state this ADR ships).\n107\t\n108\t## TS-Side Scope Revision\n109\t\n110\tWhile implementing, `libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/sensor-events.schema.ts` was audited against the ADR text. The audit found:\n111\t\n112\t- `SENSOR_METRIC_INGESTED_SCHEMA` (the schema the NATS event validator already ships) declares BOTH `rawValue` AND `value` as REQUIRED fields, with `additionalProperties: false`. That schema describes the **sidecar → NATS event** wire format, not the edge-device → MQTT payload.\n113\t- The sidecar-published `SensorMetricIngested` event is therefore already semantically V2 — there is no drift to fix on the NATS consumer side.\n114\t- The upcaster / downcaster / `payloadVersion` discriminator this ADR prescribes all belong to the **edge-device → MQTT payload** trust boundary. The Rust sidecar implements them in `payload.rs::validate` (commit `a3ab0c23`). The mirror NestJS path (`apps/sensor-service/src/ingestion/mqtt-listener.service.ts`) is tracked separately as **ORPHAN-016**; when that orphan closes, the NestJS listener applies the identical V1/V2 match + upcast tag against the MQTT payload.\n115\t\n116\t**Implication:** The ADR's original §Decision item 1 (\"Ajv schemas — `SensorPayloadV1Schema` and `SensorPayloadV2Schema`\") is **not landed as separate TS schemas** because the existing `SENSOR_METRIC_INGESTED_SCHEMA` already enforces the V2 shape on the NATS-event boundary. Item 2 (TS-side upcaster) and item 3 (downcaster) apply only when the NestJS listener is updated to speak V1/V2 on the MQTT boundary — **that work is tracked by ORPHAN-016 closure**, not by this ADR. The phase matrix (§Decision item 5) continues to apply as written; the Phase 0–2 implementation is entirely Rust-side (commit `a3ab0c23`), Phase 3 cut-over requires ORPHAN-016 closure before `INGEST_PAYLOAD_VERSION_MIN=2` can flip.\n117\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6323ea1e-ccb9-4873-9219-49241266a3fe","uuid":"0c318040-1d30-4d38-9ae3-f040dd62a1ed","timestamp":"2026-10-05T11:57:44.651Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-5718cfe3d310/docs/adr/_draft/028-sensor-payload-raw-value-contract.md","content":"- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — green.\n- `RUSTDOCFLAGS=\"-D warnings\" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --document-private-items` — green.\n- Phase-progression runbook `docs/runbooks/sensor-payload-v2-migration.md` — pending (follow-up commit; the runbook is not blocking Phase 0 posture because Phase 0 is the default-accept state this ADR ships).\n\n## TS-Side Scope Revision\n\nWhile implementing, `libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/sensor-events.schema.ts` was audited against the ADR text. The audit found:\n\n- `SENSOR_METRIC_INGESTED_SCHEMA` (the schema the NATS event validator already ships) declares BOTH `rawValue` AND `value` as REQUIRED fields, with `additionalProperties: false`. That schema describes the **sidecar → NATS event** wire format, not the edge-device → MQTT payload.\n- The sidecar-published `SensorMetricIngested` event is therefore already semantically V2 — there is no drift to fix on the NATS consumer side.\n- The upcaster / downcaster / `payloadVersion` discriminator this ADR prescribes all belong to the **edge-device → MQTT payload** trust boundary. The Rust sidecar implements them in `payload.rs::validate` (commit `a3ab0c23`). The mirror NestJS path (`apps/sensor-service/src/ingestion/mqtt-listener.service.ts`) is tracked separately as **ORPHAN-016**; when that orphan closes, the NestJS listener applies the identical V1/V2 match + upcast tag against the MQTT payload.\n\n**Implication:** The ADR's original §Decision item 1 (\"Ajv schemas — `SensorPayloadV1Schema` and `SensorPayloadV2Schema`\") is **not landed as separate TS schemas** because the existing `SENSOR_METRIC_INGESTED_SCHEMA` already enforces the V2 shape on the NATS-event boundary. Item 2 (TS-side upcaster) and item 3 (downcaster) apply only when the NestJS listener is updated to speak V1/V2 on the MQTT boundary — **that work is tracked by ORPHAN-016 closure**, not by this ADR. The phase matrix (§Decision item 5) continues to apply as written; the Phase 0–2 implementation is entirely Rust-side (commit `a3ab0c23`), Phase 3 cut-over requires ORPHAN-016 closure before `INGEST_PAYLOAD_VERSION_MIN=2` can flip.\n","numLines":14,"startLine":104,"totalLines":119}}}
